BiblicalUsage: Adelotes appears once, in Paul's charge to the rich: do not trust in 'uncertain riches.' The word names what wealth really is — something that cannot be counted on, here today and gone tomorrow. Paul sets it against the living God, who gives richly and can be trusted.
TheologicalSignificance: The word does not preach — the passage does — so I keep the two straight and let this one stay what it is; in this case, the verse is 1 Timothy 6:17.
